title: fix: restore Observability Grafana startup and health checks
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes Observability returning `Internal Server Error` after successful login: Grafana redirects the default container startup probe to public HTTPS, which the private container transport rejects.
- Probes `/grafana/api/health`, uses the same endpoint for scheduled checks, reports Grafana's actual health, and leaves proxy redirects for the browser to follow.
- Fixes deployment verification skipping the final URL without a trailing newline; adds real HTTP regression tests to the Applications workflow.
- Validation: 28 auth tests, 5 deployment tests, Biome, frontend/Worker build, Docker image and deployment dry run pass. Real Grafana reproduces the old redirect and returns 200 at the new probe. Authenticated iframe renders through the local gateway; production data and Cloudflare container rollout still need live verification (local container emulation failed internally).

gist.headline: Grafana Finds Its Way Home
gist.blurb: The observability garden’s signposts now point Grafana health checks to its local door, while browsers can still take the scenic HTTPS route. The dashboard stops getting lost after login.
gist.summary: Restored Grafana startup and post-login access by probing `/grafana/api/health` over the private container transport, while retaining browser-facing proxy redirects and adding HTTP deployment regressions.
gist.impact: Operators can again use the authenticated Grafana iframe and receive Grafana’s real health status, with deployment verification correctly checking the final URL even when its input lacks a trailing newline.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny operator headset, guides a cheerful CRT-monitor robot through a cozy garden shed observability station. A lime-green health-check path leads directly to a small Grafana dashboard door, while a separate winding HTTPS path is clearly reserved for browser visitors; little code-plants and healthy status flowers show the repaired routing.
